definition.bucket: quintile of s + v against strictly earlier weeks since 2009-01-01
definition.candidate: x = s + v with the Treasury account's contribution removed; own quintiles
definition.identity: s + v = change in reserve balances (WRBWFRBL)
definition.judgment: tilt toward growth when the bucket is 4 or higher, otherwise no tilt
definition.unit: percent of total assets 13 weeks earlier
definition.vector: minus the change in non-reserve liabilities (WALCL − WRBWFRBL)
